mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record (refund_no, order_no, payment_no, user_id, amount, fee, refund_amount, status, channel_refund_no, reason, callback_count, stock_restored, retry_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{refundNo}, #{orderNo}, #{paymentNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{fee}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, #{channelRefundNo}, #{reason}, #{callbackCount}, #{stockRestored}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, refund_no, order_no, payment_no, user_id, amount, fee, refund_amount, status, channel_refund_no, reason, callback_count, stock_restored, retry_count, create_time, update_time FROM refund_record WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo}

SELECT id, refund_no, order_no, payment_no, user_id, amount, fee, refund_amount, status, channel_refund_no, reason, callback_count, stock_restored, retry_count, create_time, update_time FROM refund_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_record SET status = '退款成功', channel_refund_no = #{channelRefundNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status = '退款中'
UPDATE refund_record SET status = '退款失败', update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status = '退款中'
UPDATE refund_record SET callback_count = callback_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, refund_no, order_no, payment_no, user_id, amount, fee, refund_amount, status, channel_refund_no, reason, callback_count, stock_restored, retry_count, create_time, update_time FROM refund_record WHERE status = '退款中' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY update_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_record SET stock_restored = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND stock_restored = 0
UPDATE refund_record SET channel_refund_no = #{channelRefundNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo}
UPDATE refund_record SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo}
UPDATE refund_record SET retry_count = 999, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND retry_count < 999
